which car tire manufacturer is famous fo: Pirelli is an Italian tire company founded in Milan in 1872. Its P Zero line is made for high-performance cars, and Pirelli has been Formula 1's exclusive tire supplier since 2011.
where are the cars of the brand \"ferrar: Ferrari builds its cars in Maranello, Italy, where the company is based. Enzo Ferrari founded the racing team in 1929 and the first car carrying his name appeared in 1947.
what is the fastest road legal car in th: In 2017 a Koenigsegg Agera RS averaged about 284 mph on a closed stretch of Nevada highway, setting a production-car speed record at the time. New claims by other carmakers have followed since.
what uk train does not go over 125mph?: "Sprinter" diesel trains are built for short regional trips and top out at roughly 75 to 90 mph. Faster InterCity 125 and Azuma trains can reach 125 mph.
the ls1 engine is how many cubic inches?: The General Motors LS1 is a 5.7-liter V8, which works out to about 346 cubic inches. It debuted in the 1997 Chevrolet Corvette and became a favorite for engine swaps.
during world war 2, with tank was the mo: The Panther (Panzerkampfwagen V) entered service in 1943 and combined thick sloped armor with a powerful long-barreled 75 mm gun, so Allied crews feared it. The heavier Tiger had a fearsome reputation too.
which of the following vehicles featured: The Renault Avantime, built from 2001 to 2003, had a huge glass roof and a coupe-minivan shape that was ahead of its time. It sold poorly and production ended after only a couple of years.
what was the first vehicle that came wit: Packard offered the first factory-installed car air conditioning in 1939. It was a bulky and expensive option that few buyers chose, and it took decades before air conditioning became common.
which of the following passenger jets is: At about 76.3 meters long, the Boeing 747-8 is the longest passenger airliner ever built. It stretched the original 747 design to carry more passengers and cargo.
what country is the hussarya supercar, m: The Arrinera Hussarya is a Polish supercar assembled in Poland. It was meant to be the country's first supercar, and its builders aimed at track performance.
which of these cars is not considered on: Ferrari's best-known supercars are the 288 GTO, F40, F50, Enzo and LaFerrari. The Testarossa of the 1980s was a famous grand tourer and sports car, but it is not on that list.
which of the following is not a russian: BYD is a Chinese company based in Shenzhen, and it is one of the world's biggest makers of electric vehicles. Russian car brands include Lada, GAZ and UAZ.
which of the following countries has off: Austria's privacy laws effectively ban private dash cams, with fines for recording in public. Rules differ a lot from country to country, so it is worth checking before using one abroad.
when was cadillac founded?: Cadillac was founded in 1902 by Henry Leland and named after Antoine de la Mothe Cadillac, who founded Detroit in 1701. It became General Motors' luxury brand in 1909.
what nickname was given to air canada fl: On July 23, 1983, Air Canada Flight 143, a Boeing 767, ran out of fuel mid-air because of a pounds-versus-kilograms mix-up. The pilots glided it to a safe landing at a former air base in Gimli, Manitoba, earning the "Gimli Glider" nickname.
what was the name of the first front-whe: The Datsun Cherry, launched in 1970, was the company's first front-wheel-drive car. Nissan later sold it in some markets under other names.
how much horsepower is produced by the s: The EMD SD40-2 is a famous diesel-electric locomotive rated at about 3,000 horsepower, and it was built in large numbers from 1972 to 1989. It was so reliable that many are still in service today.
what kind of train was stepney, a train: Stepney is a real locomotive, an LB&SCR A1X "Terrier" tank engine built in 1875. He appears in the Reverend W. Awdry's Railway Series (Thomas the Tank Engine) and now runs on the Bluebell Railway in Sussex.
which of these is not a car model produc: The Kelisa is a Perodua model, not a Proton. Perodua and Proton are Malaysia's two national car makers, and Proton's models include the Saga, Wira and Persona.
which of the following fia rally cars wa: Group B was a rally category that ran from 1982 to 1986 and allowed extremely powerful, lightly regulated cars like the Audi Quattro, Lancia 037 and Peugeot 205 T16. It was shut down after serious accidents.
which audi does not use haldex based all: The Audi A8 uses a Torsen-based quattro system rather than a Haldex clutch. Haldex was mostly used by Audi on smaller front-engine-sideways models, such as the A3 and TT.
in 2014, over 6 million general motors v: In 2014 General Motors recalled millions of vehicles because a faulty ignition switch could turn off the engine and disable the airbags. It was linked to over 100 deaths and led to a large compensation fund.
what year did the chevrolet luv mini tru: The Chevrolet LUV (Light Utility Vehicle) was a small pickup that first went on sale in 1972. It was built by Isuzu in Japan and sold under the Chevrolet name in the United States.
what model was the sports car gifted to: Yuri Gagarin, the first human in space, was given a Matra Djet sports car in 1965. It was a small French car with a mid-mounted engine and a fiberglass body.
which variable valve timing technology i: VANOS is BMW's variable valve timing system, first used in 1992. The name comes from the German "Variable Nockenwellensteuerung", or variable camshaft control.
volkswagen's legendary vr6 engine has cy: The VR6 is a narrow-angle V6 whose cylinders sit at just 15 degrees, so it fits in a compact space like an inline engine. Volkswagen introduced it in 1991.
what engine is in the lexus sc400?: The Lexus SC400 uses the 1UZ-FE, a 4.0-liter V8 also found in the LS400 sedan. This engine is respected for its smoothness and long life.
